description: Source code for an authentication and authorization service implementing token-based auth, RBAC, user management, and Segregation of Duties, designed for a FastAPI application.

classes.name: AuthService
classes.description: Handles authentication, token creation/validation, user management, role assignment, and Segregation of Duties enforcement.

methods.name: set_registration_enabled
methods.description: Sets runtime flag to enable or disable registration.

methods.name: is_registration_enabled
methods.description: Checks if registration is enabled, considering runtime override and environment variable.

methods.name: verify_password
methods.description: Verifies a password against stored hash and salt.

methods.name: create_token
methods.description: Creates a signed bearer token with user info and roles.

methods.name: decode_token
methods.description: Decodes and validates a bearer token, supporting test tokens and production format.

methods.name: get_current_user
methods.description: Extracts and validates user info from the token, auto-provisions users for test tokens.

methods.name: create_user
methods.description: Creates a new user with specified roles.

methods.name: authenticate_user
methods.description: Authenticates user credentials and returns a token.

methods.name: assign_role
methods.description: Assigns an additional role to a user, with permission checks.

methods.name: enforce_sod
methods.description: Enforces Segregation of Duties by preventing submitter and approver from being the same.

methods.name: get_current_user_dep
methods.description: FastAPI dependency to get current authenticated user.

methods.name: require_roles
methods.description: FastAPI dependency factory to enforce role-based access control.
